chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The violet (oil) is the chief of your oils.

key_terms.أَدْهَانِكُمْ: Your oils (plural of oil, often referring to massage or anointing oils)

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best oil according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies violet oil (*al-banafaj*) as the 'master' or most superior of all oils, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the purity and fragrance of natural substances used for personal adornment and ritual preparation. This designation underscores the spiritual and physical value of scent in Islamic tradition, linking aesthetic refinement with inner purity.
